fields.statement: Change set 01M6J965 (resume runs stranded after their change set landed) serves no intent yet. Which landed intent should it serve? m4-runs-hold-up says 'A build, review or ship-change run finishes without hand repair', which is what this fixes. / Draft change set 01M6H5VQ already covers the plan-run half: inbox and daemon treat an interrupted plan run whose record landed as resumable (rhiza run resume already continues one, plan-run-resumes-landed-record). Should 01M6J965 leave plan runs to it and cover only non-plan (ship-change) runs? / What makes a ship-change run on a landed change set resumable? `rhiza ship land` already skips a change set that has landed, so re-running it is safe.
